digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage workflow exception handling
propositions: Mid-run exception handlers in gate_dispatch.py (produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate) that catch LLMInputRejectedError alongside LLMUnavailableError have no test coverage reaching them
Container warm-call abort in container_stage._run_container has no test coverage and its abort-vs-degrade decision is unpinned
Plan-review mid-run arm is reachable in production via batch-runner path through ProductionBatchRunner and container warm-call abort, not dead code
Code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract with no proven in-tree production path reaching it; reachability is unresolved
Test suite must cover both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError raising through real run_workflow and _run_container paths with seam-fidelity checks
